n9c383c14d4.headline: Bunzl Plc Reiterates 2025 Guidance Ahead Of Year End Update
n9c383c14d4.summary: Bunzl has reaffirmed its 2025 adjusted operating profit guidance ahead of its closed period, with group revenue expected to grow 2% to 3% at constant exchange rates.
n9c383c14d4.why: Bunzl is a London-listed distributor of disposable and consumables products. Its guidance signals expected trading and profit levels to shareholders.

n345a8cd939.headline: Supporters of Tunisia’s Saied rally amid deepening political divisions
n345a8cd939.summary: Supporters of President Kais Saied rallied in Tunis against the opposition as street protests grew, amid an economic crisis marked by high inflation, shortages of basic goods and poor public services.
n345a8cd939.why: Political instability and economic stress affect Tunisia's ability to secure financing and reforms. Investors track these conditions when assessing sovereign risk.

n1aa5a151ba.headline: FBR tax for filers, non-filers on debit cards, prize bonds [January 2026 Update]
n1aa5a151ba.summary: The Federal Board of Revenue has introduced a significant distinction between tax rates for filers and non-filers for the current fiscal year. The update also covers debit card transactions and prize bonds.
n1aa5a151ba.why: The Federal Board of Revenue is Pakistan's tax authority, and changes to tax rates affect government revenue and compliance across the economy.

n483e448ea6.headline: Cora Gold Raises £1.05m To Progress Sanankoro Gold Project
n483e448ea6.summary: Cora Gold has conditionally raised £1.05 million before expenses through the issue of 17.47 million new ordinary shares at 6 pence each. The funds are to progress its Sanankoro gold project.
n483e448ea6.why: Junior gold miners raise equity to fund exploration and development, and gold project progress depends heavily on financing.

ndceccfddbd.headline: Jubilee Reports FY2025 Results As Copper Focus Sharpens Ahead Of Disposal
ndceccfddbd.summary: Jubilee has published audited results for the year to 30 June 2025, covering continuing Zambian copper operations. Its South African chrome and PGM assets are classified as held for sale.
ndceccfddbd.why: Copper is a key industrial metal used in electrification, and miners' asset sales and operational focus affect supply and valuations.

n64fb70746e.headline: Hannover Re secures $250m 3264 Re retro cat bond, the largest yet in the program - Artemis.bm
n64fb70746e.summary: Hannover Re has secured the upsized target of $250 million of North American peak peril retrocession through its new 3264 Re Ltd. (Series 2025-3). The deal is the largest yet in the program.
n64fb70746e.why: Hannover Re is a German global reinsurer that transfers catastrophe risk to capital markets through cat bonds. These instruments let reinsurers diversify risk and access investor capital.

n185cfc7abe.headline: Alexander highlights ‘stark contrast’ in talks on Grangemouth and Mossmorran
n185cfc7abe.summary: The Scottish Secretary said Mossmorran management, unlike Grangemouth's, had not been able to demonstrate a pathway to profitability. He highlighted a stark contrast in the talks on the two Scottish petrochemical sites.
n185cfc7abe.why: Grangemouth and Mossmorran are Scottish industrial sites involved in refining and petrochemicals. Their viability affects regional energy supply, jobs and the UK's chemicals industry.

n5435a81d14.headline: South African rand strengthens after economic data
n5435a81d14.summary: The South African rand gained after domestic data showed the leading business cycle indicator picked up in October from September, slightly softer than expected. The rand is traded in Johannesburg.
n5435a81d14.why: The rand is South Africa's currency, and leading indicators give an early read on the direction of the economy.

impacts.name: South African rand
impacts.why: Stronger-than-feared economic data tends to support the currency.

nd9c322e809.headline: Kenya: Govt Travel Costs Hit Sh4.97 Billion in Three Months Despite Austerity Pledge
nd9c322e809.summary: Kenya's national government spent nearly Sh5 billion on travel in the first three months of the 2025/26 fiscal year. The spending raises questions about austerity measures promised by President William Ruto.
nd9c322e809.why: Government spending levels affect Kenya's fiscal deficit and borrowing needs, which matter to its debt investors.

n98487e7e19.headline: Soybeans Bouncing Off Midweek Lows
n98487e7e19.summary: Soybean contracts were down 1 to 2 1/2 cents on Wednesday after bouncing off early lows. Soymeal futures were $3.30 lower and soyoil was steady at midday, with USDA data cited in the report.
n98487e7e19.why: Soybeans are a major agricultural commodity used in animal feed and cooking oil, and their futures prices influence food and biofuel costs.

impacts.why: Soybean futures traded lower on the session.

n8d5ce61f6d.headline: Major Brexit U-turn will cost the UK taxpayer £200M and benefit EU
n8d5ce61f6d.summary: Britain is set to rejoin a major EU programme, reversing part of its post-Brexit approach. The move is reported to cost UK taxpayers £200 million while benefiting the EU.
n8d5ce61f6d.why: Decisions on EU programme participation affect UK public spending and the terms of post-Brexit trade and cooperation.

n3ff51533cb.headline: Central Bank of Nigeria revokes licenses of two banks
n3ff51533cb.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria has revoked the operating licences of two mortgage banks, a circular issued on Tuesday said. The move is part of efforts to reposition the mortgage sub-sector.
n3ff51533cb.why: Mortgage banks finance housing in Nigeria, and central bank licensing decisions shape lender stability and credit access in the sector.

n1a1ee41258.headline: Groupama gets upsized €120m convective storm reinsurance with Quercus II Re cat bond - Artemis.bm
n1a1ee41258.summary: Groupama, the French mutual insurer and reinsurer, has priced its Quercus II Re DAC catastrophe bond, securing an upsized target for convective storm reinsurance cover.
n1a1ee41258.why: Catastrophe bonds transfer insurance risk to capital market investors, and insurers like Groupama use them to hedge large weather losses.

nb294790963.summary: Volkswagen Group has become the top-selling electric vehicle brand in Europe, overtaking Tesla over the first 10 months of the year.
nb294790963.why: Volkswagen Group is one of Europe's largest carmakers, and shifts in EV market share affect automakers' revenue and their regulatory compliance costs.

nd70867355e.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange closed marginally lower on December 17, with the General Index down 0.14%. Losses in Eurobank and OPAP led the decline.
nd70867355e.why: The Athens General Index tracks the main listed companies on the Greek stock exchange, which reflects the performance of Greece's banking and consumer sectors.

n108e436e2c.summary: Corn futures traded 2 to 4½ cents higher midday on Wednesday, supported by record ethanol production and solid exports. USDA reported a private export sale of 177,055 MT.
n108e436e2c.why: Corn is a major feed and biofuel crop, and its futures prices reflect supply, ethanol demand and export flows that affect food and energy costs.

n1f792803b5.summary: Silver prices hit fresh all-time highs on the Multi Commodity Exchange in Mumbai, rising over 4%. Strong global cues and rising expectations of interest rate cuts drove the metal higher.
n1f792803b5.why: Silver is a precious metal used as a store of value and in industrial applications, and it tends to respond to interest-rate expectations.

n24b670fe61.headline: Digital bank Monzo gains a full European banking licence
n24b670fe61.summary: UK-based digital bank Monzo has acquired a full banking licence from the Central Bank of Ireland, allowing it to expand into Europe. The licence is also cited from another regulator.
n24b670fe61.why: Monzo is a UK digital bank, and a full EU licence lets it offer banking services across the European Economic Area without a separate local licence.

ne159328692.headline: UN Flags 'Radical' Rights Restrictions in Venezuela, Warns Civilians May Be 'Caught in the Crossfire' as U.S. Pressure Rises
ne159328692.summary: The United Nations warned that Venezuela's human rights situation has deteriorated since June, citing radical restrictions on freedoms and arbitrary detentions. It also flagged growing militarization amid rising US pressure.
ne159328692.why: Political instability and US sanctions policy affect Venezuela's oil output and debt, which matter to energy and emerging-market investors.

nff9870ef8b.headline: Serco Appoints Mark Reid As Group Chief Financial Officer
nff9870ef8b.summary: Serco Group has appointed Mark Reid as Group Chief Financial Officer and Executive Director, effective 6 March 2026.
nff9870ef8b.why: Serco is a UK public services contractor, and changes in its finance leadership can matter for investors tracking its governance and reporting.

n0ce68681f0.headline: Warner Bros. urges shareholders to reject hostile Paramount offer
n0ce68681f0.summary: Warner Bros. Discovery is urging shareholders to reject a hostile buyout bid from Paramount Skydance. It is sticking with the $72 billion Netflix offer Warner agreed earlier this month.
n0ce68681f0.why: Warner Bros. Discovery is a major US media and entertainment company. Competing takeover bids for large media groups shape valuations and deal risk for both the target and bidders.

impacts.name: Netflix
impacts.why: Netflix's agreed $72 billion offer is the competing deal Warner is backing.

nd17ced76e6.headline: Indian Rupee Likely To Bounce Back Strongly In H2 Of Next Fiscal Despite Global Pressures: SBI Report
nd17ced76e6.summary: SBI Research attributes the rupee's sharp fall to geopolitical uncertainty and delays in the India-US trade deal. It expects a strong rebound in the second half of the next fiscal year.
nd17ced76e6.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and returns for foreign investors in Indian assets. SBI is India's largest state-run lender and its research is closely watched.

nb93b144d32.headline: State pensioners born in certain years handed extra £575 from DWP
nb93b144d32.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves has confirmed the basic and new state pension will rise by 4.8%. The increase benefits pensioners born in certain years.
nb93b144d32.why: The state pension is the main income for many UK retirees, and its annual uprating affects government spending and household income. The rise follows the government's pension indexation policy.

nc5dc7652b4.headline: New Zealand’s economy returns to growth in third quarter
nc5dc7652b4.summary: New Zealand's economy returned to growth in the third quarter. Business services were the largest contributor to the increase in GDP.
nc5dc7652b4.why: GDP growth data shapes expectations for the Reserve Bank of New Zealand's interest rate decisions and the New Zealand dollar. Business services are a large part of the economy.

n463d3d1161.headline: ON TARGET: Fast-Tracking the Canadian Army's New Assault Rifles
n463d3d1161.summary: CBC reports Canada's Army is accelerating plans to replace its C-7 and C-8 rifles under the Canadian Modular Assault Rifle program. The project could expand and support domestic manufacturing.
n463d3d1161.why: Defence procurement programmes give domestic manufacturers and suppliers contract opportunities, and spending levels reflect national budget priorities.

n20740aac44.headline: Indian malls to attract over $3.5 billion in investments over next 3 years
n20740aac44.summary: BusinessLine reports that Indian malls are set to attract over $3.5 billion in investments over the next three years. The report cites robust consumer demand and institutional investor confidence.
n20740aac44.why: Mall investment reflects the capital flowing into India's retail real estate, a sector tied to consumer spending growth.

nef68133e64.headline: Trump's rush to build nuclear reactors across the U.S. raises safety worries
nef68133e64.summary: A new Department of Energy program is pushing development of nearly a dozen new reactor designs at breakneck speed. The rapid pace has raised safety concerns.
nef68133e64.why: Nuclear power development involves long-lived capital projects and regulatory approvals, which affect utilities, reactor vendors and electricity supply planning.

nccd559f3cc.headline: Chalmers spins battery blowout into budget savings
nccd559f3cc.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers has used accounting to present government policy decisions as improving the budget bottom line. The report describes the approach as clever accounting.
nccd559f3cc.why: Australia's federal budget sets fiscal policy and borrowing needs, which influence government bond yields and the Australian dollar.

n8aecd06e73.headline: HMRC told to introduce new car rules and end tax loophole for drivers
n8aecd06e73.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves has provided an update on changes to Employee Car Ownership Schemes, with HMRC asked to introduce new car rules and close a tax loophole.
n8aecd06e73.why: Employee car schemes carry tax treatment that affects employers, staff and leasing providers in the UK.

nb6150b5267.headline: How the long-running Obamacare fight came to thwart enhanced subsidies in Congress
nb6150b5267.summary: Congress is poised to leave for its scheduled holiday recess without a solution to the expiration of enhanced subsidies for Affordable Care Act marketplace plans.
nb6150b5267.why: Enhanced ACA subsidies affect health insurance costs for millions of Americans and the financial outlook of insurers operating in the marketplaces.

n11fa67fdb9.headline: Aspire secures Electronic Money Institution licence in EU
n11fa67fdb9.summary: Aspire has secured an Electronic Money Institution licence in the EU. It has also signed an investment commitment with the Dutch Ministry of Economic Affairs, selecting the Netherlands as its regional base.
n11fa67fdb9.why: An electronic money licence allows a fintech to issue e-money and offer payment services across the EU under one regulator.

n72747fa76a.headline: Trump's economic approval hits a new low at 36%, poll finds
n72747fa76a.summary: A NPR/PBS News/Marist poll found 36% approval of President Trump's handling of the economy. Seventy percent of Americans said things have become too unaffordable.
n72747fa76a.why: Public sentiment on the economy can influence policy direction and the political outlook for fiscal and trade decisions.

n7e8cf43956.headline: AI Computing Expansion Drives Wafer Equipment Outlook SEMI Forecasts 2026 Sales to Reach US$126 Billion
n7e8cf43956.summary: SEMI forecasts 2026 wafer equipment sales will reach US$126 billion, driven by rapid expansion in AI computing. The report was covered by Taiwan's Fan News.
n7e8cf43956.why: SEMI is the global industry association for semiconductor equipment makers, and its forecasts are a closely watched gauge of chip capital spending. Wafer equipment orders signal demand for the chip supply chain.

n5fbc73412a.headline: UK and Ghana co-host ADF-17 pledging conference in London to drive African development
n5fbc73412a.summary: The UK and Ghana co-hosted the 17th replenishment of the African Development Fund at the EBRD headquarters in London. Partners met to mobilise resources for Africa's development, with Ghana's deputy finance minister speaking.
n5fbc73412a.why: The African Development Fund is the concessional lending arm of the African Development Bank, funding infrastructure and development projects across African countries. Replenishment pledges set its lending capacity for several years.

n31547b4db7.headline: We’re in for a worrying time with the increase in RAM prices
n31547b4db7.summary: Samsung has raised the wholesale price of DDR5 memory by more than 100%, citing a lack of stock. The increase adds to concerns about rising RAM prices for consumers.
n31547b4db7.why: Samsung Electronics is one of the world's largest memory chip makers, so its pricing shapes costs across the PC, smartphone and data center supply chains.

ne1c63440e2.headline: Elemental Royalty CEO David Cole On Merger Synergies And Global Royalty Growth
ne1c63440e2.summary: Elemental Royalty CEO David Cole discussed the merger of Elemental Altus and EMX Royalty, and a portfolio of over 300 mineral royalty assets across 20 countries.
ne1c63440e2.why: Mineral royalty companies earn payments linked to mine output without bearing operating costs, so their portfolios and deals depend on metal and mining activity.

n2c5a9c9cac.headline: IPO activity stalls in Philippines amid market slump and fallout from flood control scandal
n2c5a9c9cac.summary: Initial public offerings on the Philippine Stock Exchange slumped to just two this year. Analysts cited uncertainty over US tariffs and a high-profile corruption scandal weighing on sentiment.
n2c5a9c9cac.why: IPO volume is a gauge of companies' willingness to raise equity capital and of investor appetite in a stock market.

nb62588d479.headline: Vena Energy lines up P7-billion foreign funding for 300-MW Ilocos solar project
nb62588d479.summary: Singapore-based Vena Energy said it has secured foreign financing of P7 billion for its 300-megawatt solar project in Ilocos Norte, Philippines. The company announced the funding on Wednesday.
nb62588d479.why: Vena Energy is a renewable energy developer, and project financing indicates investor confidence in large-scale solar development in the Philippines.

n9e7856643a.headline: Revenues from Asset-Related Taxes in Austria Lower Than Ever Before
n9e7856643a.summary: Austria's union federation ÖGB, citing OECD data, says wealth-related tax revenues were just 0.98% of total tax and levy revenue in 2024. It is again calling for wealth and inheritance taxes.
n9e7856643a.why: Tax policy changes such as wealth or inheritance taxes affect public finances, fiscal planning and the investment climate for wealthy households.

n3261b7dd72.headline: EMEA Morning Briefing :  Oil, Gold Rise After Trump Orders Venezuela Blockade
n3261b7dd72.summary: Oil and gold prices rose after US President Donald Trump ordered a blockade of Venezuela. European stock futures edged higher after Asian shares broadly gained.
n3261b7dd72.why: Venezuela holds large oil reserves, and supply disruptions there move crude prices, while gold typically attracts demand during geopolitical stress.
n3261b7dd72.why_moved: A US blockade of Venezuela threatens its oil exports, raising supply concerns. Gold tends to gain as investors seek safe havens during geopolitical tension.

n49c295d73f.headline: Federal Land divests 52% stake in Crown Central
n49c295d73f.summary: Federal Land, the property arm of GT Capital Holdings, and its subsidiary Horizon Land Property have divested a 52% stake in Crown Central. Further details were not included in the input.
n49c295d73f.why: GT Capital is a Philippine conglomerate with property and banking interests, and stake sales reshape its portfolio.

n6858f2668c.headline: House approves bill amending bank secrecy law on second reading
n6858f2668c.summary: The Philippine House of Representatives on Monday approved on second reading a bill amending the country's decades-old bank secrecy law. The bill still needs further legislative steps.
n6858f2668c.why: Bank secrecy rules govern access to depositor information, so changes affect banks, regulators and anti-money-laundering compliance in the Philippines.

nbd39d12fe0.headline: Banks’ real estate exposure slips
nbd39d12fe0.summary: Philippine banks and trust entities reduced their exposure to the property sector at the end of September. The decline reflected lower real estate investments, according to Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas data.
nbd39d12fe0.why: Bank property lending exposure is a key indicator of credit risk in the real estate sector, closely watched by Philippine regulators and investors.

n5eb1e4d995.headline: Monzo board reportedly pushed out CEO Anil over IPO timing
n5eb1e4d995.summary: Monzo's board reportedly removed CEO Anil, with IPO timing reported as a key issue. The report does not detail the wider reasons behind the decision.
n5eb1e4d995.why: Monzo is a UK digital bank, and leadership changes and IPO timing shape investor confidence in fintech listings.

n5dc20907ac.headline: Sensex, Nifty trade flat in early deals amid weak global cues
n5dc20907ac.summary: Indian equity benchmarks Sensex and Nifty traded flat in early deals on Wednesday. Mixed trends in banking stocks kept investors cautious.
n5dc20907ac.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmark indices of India's stock market, tracking large listed companies.

nd4e0f0137c.headline: AMRO says impact of BSP rate adjustments are delayed, limited
nd4e0f0137c.summary: The ASEAN+3 Macroeconomic Research Office says transmission of Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas rate adjustments into the financial system is delayed and limited.
nd4e0f0137c.why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the Philippine central bank, and its rate decisions affect peso assets and local borrowing costs.

n988fed1ad4.headline: PNB, Discovery Capital Finance ink partnership to boost SME lending
n988fed1ad4.summary: Philippine National Bank has partnered with Discovery Capital Finance Corp. on a loan facility to boost lending to small and medium enterprises.
n988fed1ad4.why: Philippine National Bank is one of the country's major commercial banks, and SME lending supports local economic growth.

n9ffcef1ede.headline: Cyclone Ditwah Causes ₹75 Billion Damage In Sri Lanka; Roads, Bridges, Power, & Water Infrastructure Hit
n9ffcef1ede.summary: Sri Lanka's Road Development Authority reported losses of nearly Rs 75 billion from Cyclone Ditwah, with rehabilitation estimated at Rs 190 billion. Power and water utilities also suffered losses, and the World Bank and ADB are expected to fund reconstruction.
n9ffcef1ede.why: Sri Lanka is a South Asian island economy whose infrastructure spending, sovereign borrowing and multilateral lending are closely watched by investors in frontier and emerging debt.

n3ee975e6f1.headline: Diageo selling major stake in East African Breweries
n3ee975e6f1.summary: Diageo is selling its 65% stake in East African Breweries (EABL) for $2.3 billion to Asahi. The report describes it as the first major Japanese investment in an African alcohol business.
n3ee975e6f1.why: Diageo is a global spirits and beer company, and Asahi is a Japanese brewer; such stake sales reshape ownership of major consumer businesses in emerging markets.

n5352463565.summary: The Philippine peso slipped against the dollar on Wednesday amid a lack of catalysts and as oil prices moved.
n5352463565.why: The peso's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and the value of foreign-currency assets held by Philippine investors.

n9b3efc5850.headline: Nuvei Receives License Under EU MiCAR
n9b3efc5850.summary: Nuvei has received a Crypto-Asset Service Provider licence under the European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCAR).
n9b3efc5850.why: MiCA is the EU's framework for crypto-asset services, and licences let payment and fintech firms offer those services across EU member states.
